name: llm-seo-lab
description: Citation-pull engineering for AI search. Runs TRIZ + attractor-flow + Pratyaksha against any web page, Substack post, or YouTube video and emits substrate-correct artifacts (PR diffs, paste-ready Markdown, YT Studio checklists). Multi-stage, human-gated; the v0.2.0 closed-loop /aeo:* commands are kept alongside. Powered by the Claude Code subscription CLI.
